text:
alex: FYI restore for tenant=zephyr failed with KMS Decrypt missing in our audit trail. getting AccessDenied but CloudTrail has no matching kms:Decrypt event.
security-bot: Alert: restore-decrypt-error tenant=zephyr - AccessDeniedException
laura: that's odd, CloudTrail should capture kms:Decrypt. are we sure the caller is using the role we expect? alex, can you paste the agent logs?
alex: logs snippet:
```
2026-04-05T09:12:03Z restore: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException for arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/backup-session-role/session-abc123
```
ben: i searched CloudTrail for the time window and only found sts:AssumeRole and s3:GetObject, but no kms:Decrypt entry.
priya: could be CloudTrail event sampling or event selector misconfig. last config change was two weeks ago to reduce costs (we toggled advanced event selectors).
log-bot: Config change detected: CloudTrail advancedEventSelectors updated by infra-cfg-bot at 2026-03-22T02:03:00Z - kmsDataEvents reduced to 1% sampling.
laura: ugh. that's the reason. sampling dropped kms data events. we don't have the forensic event to see which principal attempted Decrypt.
eng-oncall: mitigation: 1) turn sampling to 100% for kmsDataEvents immediately 2) create temporary grant for assumed role or attach decrypt policy 3) replay restore after grant in place.
ben: flipping CloudTrail selector now:
```
aws cloudtrail update-trail --name redwood-main --advanced-event-selectors file://enable-kms-full.json
```
ben: done. advancedEventSelectors now include full KMS data events for the backup key.
priya: while that's rolling, can we confirm if the assumed-role has a session policy that denies kms:Decrypt? Some of our session-tag gating denies on tag=env=prod mismatch.
alex: grep in auth logs: session tag env=staging for this session. looks like a broken CI job assumed prod role but passed staging tag because of an env var bug.
laura: so two failures aligned: audit sampling hid the event and a session-tag mismatch caused deny. layered failure.
eng-oncall: immediate actions taken: - CloudTrail kmsDataEvents sampling -> 100% - created grant for arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/backup-session-role/session-abc123 equivalent principal: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-session-role (temp) - restarted restore job (small snapshot)
alex: verification: small restore succeeded after grant. decrypts show up in CloudTrail now.
laura: postmortem items: 1) revert sampling change and add review policy for event selector changes 2) add CI test to ensure session tags set correctly for backup jobs 3) alert on missing kms:Decrypt events when a restore or snapshot job errors for a CMK-backed object 4) ensure grants are rebinding during role rotation/rename flow
priya: creating followup ticket SEC-2026-889 with checklist and owners. adding a short runbook note about audit sampling being a single-point-of-failure for forensics.
ben: small recommendation: add an EventBridge rule that triggers if UpdateTrail or PutEventSelectors happens to notify sec-ops channel for changes.
log-bot: EventBridge rule created: notify-sec-on-trail-change (owner: infra).
security-bot: Incident mitigated -> temporary grant created and sampling restored. Postmortem ticket SEC-2026-889 opened.
alex: thanks all. surprising coupling between cost optimization and incident response. lesson: don't save forensics money at the expense of runbook signal.
